reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS multi_unit_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY parent_category
